positions.description: Fritz helps you optimize, deploy, and manage machine learning models on every mobile device and platform.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead engineer on Data Insights team, responsible for collecting user data and behaviors relevant for product, marketing, and sales teams.

Helped build Jana's self-service campaign creation platform (both backend and frontend) which included refactoring much of the code supporting all currently running campaigns.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed new accounting report system used by Jana for reporting all revenue and expenses on a campaign level.

Helped build data pipelines using a combination of Hadoop, MySQL, and Kafka to support product analytics.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Worked in the Nick Turke-Brown lab to develop new methods of analyzing fMRI data.
